desc: Zeus Arms "ARTEMIS" AR-15 Lower Receiver. The Artemis series lower is cut from a solid block of 7075 Aluminum. The 1/2 and 1/2 series is unique as it has lightweight cuts on the side with a skeletonized magwell to add an appealing look and it also shows no visible markings on the sides of the receiver maximizing the amount of space for customization. All of our lowers feature a more aggressive magwell flare and a upper retention threaded hole.
